# SocialBug Media

> SocialBug Media is an influencer and creator marketing agency based in India, helping SaaS companies, startups, D2C brands, and founders grow through a curated network of 1000+ influencers, creators, and tech professionals across LinkedIn, Instagram, X (Twitter), and YouTube.

SocialBug Media runs end-to-end social and creator marketing campaigns: LinkedIn & X creator campaigns, Instagram/YouTube tech and fintech campaigns, LinkedIn founder and brand page amplification, Product Hunt launch marketing, founder and personal branding, and meme marketing. The agency has delivered 100+ campaigns for brands including Myntra, Flipkart, Amazon Prime Video, boAt, Suzlon, Supertails, HK Vitals, CoinSwitch, Nebius, and BlackBerry.

Founders: Mansi Gupta (Founder) and Shivam Chhirolya (Co-Founder, ex-Qualcomm, ex-ISRO, IISc Bangalore, 200K+ LinkedIn followers).
